verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports background-style automation via its CLI (usable from cron or other schedulers) and agents that autonomously claim and work tasks in a repo, but it explicitly gates all agent actions behind a mandatory human approval step ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract'), meaning true unattended autonomy is limited. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of scheduled/recurring automation setups, evidence of fully unattended runs without approval gating, and details on monitoring/alerting for background tasks.
